title: General.
officialText:
Toilet facilities shall be provided for construction workers and such facilities shall be maintained in a sanitary
condition. Construction worker toilet facilities of the nonsewer type shall conform to ANSI Z4.3.
SECTION PC 312
TESTS AND INSPECTIONS
